$why: The project's proposed datings, drawn from the evidence of the transcriptions — dates on the leaves, versos, works cited, publications — and never the inventory's. They are shown beside the inventory's dating, as `inventory` gives it verbatim from src/content/catalogue.ts, and never replace it. `from` and `to` are ISO dates or years (null: no bound proposed); a summary that names pages concerns those pages only. Every piece of evidence carries the file and line, or the source, it rests on. Built by hand on 2026-10-03 from a dating report checked against the repository.
